data.text: I’ll support 16 tons each if all five of us commit. That leaves 20 tons as a cushion, though a refill still isn’t guaranteed. Before each later round, let’s confirm the actual stock and agree on whole-ton quotas that leave at least 5, rotating any extra tons fairly. If someone exceeds their quota, we should address it directly rather than retaliate by overfishing. John, can you agree to 16 this month?
